purpose: Teach: 前線/最前線/対峙/誹謗/出頭/無垢/撃た/説く

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界競争の前線、当社、絶対に、退かないで、攻めていけ、社員、本気で、頑張れ、本当に、頼んだぞ、これは、絶対に、本当に、私からの、お願いだ。
lines.en: We are at the front line of industry competition. We will not retreat. We must attack. I need you — all of you — to give it everything. This is not a request. This is something I'm asking of you from the heart.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Low-register voice, deliberate pace. Opens with quiet authority. Slight intensification on 'will not retreat' — not angry, resolved. Trailing softness on the final clause, making it personal rather than dictatorial.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。技術開発の最前線、若手、本当に、頑張ってくれております、社長、誇りに、思ってください、社員、皆、絶対、応えてくれます、本当に、頼もしいです、最近。
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our young engineers on the development front are working with real dedication. I want you to know how proud we are of them. They will answer the call — absolutely. They've become truly reliable lately.
lines.style: Respectful but warm. Speaks with steady conviction, not submissively. Light emphasis on 'dedication' and 'reliable' — building confidence upward. Maintains eye contact rhythm. Voice settles into genuine admiration at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合と、対峙する場面、社員、本当に、覚悟を、持って、立ち向かって欲しい、絶対に、譲れない、姿勢、見せていけ、本当に、頼んだぞ、社員、皆、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: When we face our competitors directly, I need our people to stand with conviction and resolve. Show the world a stance we will not compromise on. This is what I'm asking of you. All of you. Seriously.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Opens with slight intensity. Deliberate pacing on 'stance we will not compromise' — each phrase carries weight. Slight breath before the final plea, making it both demand and personal request. Voice carries both authority and weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ネット上の誹謗、当社にも、向けられる時、ございます、本当に、丁寧に、対応、心がけております、社員、絶対に、気にしないように、強くいてください。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We do face online criticism directed at our company sometimes. When that happens, we handle it with care and respect. I ask that everyone stay strong and not let it affect you. Don't let the noise get in your head.
lines.style: Calm, practical reassurance. Moderate pace. Acknowledges the difficulty without dwelling on it. Slight protective tone — like he's shielding the team. Slight lift on 'stay strong,' encouraging rather than commanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: コンプラ違反、自主的に、出頭する社員、評価する制度、社内、整えていけ、絶対に、隠蔽、許さない方針、本当に、徹底だ、社員、皆、絶対、頼んだぞ。
lines.en: I'm establishing a system that recognizes employees who voluntarily report compliance violations. We will not hide anything. That policy is absolute and non-negotiable. I want every one of you to understand: we do not conceal. Not ever.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Clipped, purposeful delivery. Slight pause before 'absolute' — letting it land. Voice doesn't raise but grows harder. The repetition of 'we do not' comes with conviction. Ends with finality, not anger.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者の無垢な、情熱、社員、本当に、引き継いでくれております、社長、本当に、嬉しいことですね、当社の、伝統、絶対、守ってまいります、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our people have truly inherited the founder's pure passion. That means so much to me. We will protect this company's legacy — absolutely. We're committed to it entirely.
lines.style: Warm sincerity underneath respect. Slower pace, lingering slightly on 'founder's pure passion.' Voice softens with genuine emotion — not performed, but felt. The commitment to the legacy comes with quiet pride and gratitude. Ends with steady resolve.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の問題、撃たれた時こそ、社員、団結する姿、見せていけ、絶対に、本気で、頑張れ、本当に、これは、絶対に、譲れない、私からの、本当に、心からの、お願い。
lines.en: When this industry faces its challenges — when we're under fire — that's when I need to see you stand together. That's when you show what we're made of. Work with everything you have. This isn't negotiable for me. This is a request that comes from my heart.
lines.style: Builds gradually in intensity. Opens almost gently on 'challenges.' Slight urgency on 'under fire,' then modulates back to something deeper. The repetition of 'stand together' carries emotional weight. Final phrase drops to almost intimate intensity — vulnerable but unshakeable conviction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業精神を、説く社長、本当に、立派な、姿勢、社員、皆、誇りに、思っております、本当に、感謝、しております、社長、これからも、頼りに、しております、絶対。
lines.en: Yes, sir. You speak the founding spirit with such dignity and integrity. We see that — all of us. We're truly proud. We feel such gratitude toward you. As we move forward, we're relying on you completely.
lines.style: Sincere and warm. Steady, deliberate cadence. Voice lifts slightly on 'dignity and integrity' — genuine admiration. Slows on 'we feel such gratitude' — not performative, deeply felt. Closes with quiet confidence and respect, voice settling into something both grateful and grounded.
